Name: Animated Slime Eggs and Loot
Author: Gervig91
Description:
[size=6][u][b]Animated Slime Eggs and Loot

[/b][/u][/size][size=3]Adds animation for all 4 differently coloured slime eggs, treasure chest, slime, pearl, golden pumpkin, void and solar essence.
[/size]
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/WpG7sSH.gif[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/9VksEqY.gif[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/4Pa9tCo.gif[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/Clgx3lJ.gif[/img][/center]
[size=5][size=2]2.0.0 Changed the mod name to Animated Slime Eggs and Loot, added animations for 6 new items.
2.1.0 Added animations to some stuff from the 1.5 update.
[/size]
[/size][u][size=5][b]Installation[/b][/size][/u]
[size=3]Make sure to have the latest versions of the required mods:
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
- and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]SpaceCore﻿[/url]
Drop the mod into your Stardew Valley mods folder, load up the game. Enjoy :)

[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/YIYR1hu.gif[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/eClC5gg.gif[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/lJrbwu8.gif[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/sM74Ygo.gif[/img][/center][/size]

[size=5][u][b]Config[/b][/u][/size]
[size=3]There is a [i]config.json[/i] in the mod folder where you can disable/enable each animation. Simply change "true" to "false", if you want to disable or reverse if you want to enable an animation.
You can also change the speed of the animation in the [i]content.json[/i] file, change the "AnimationFrameTime": x, to however long you want the animation to be.

[size=3]Some items have different versions, for example: "TreasureChest1" and "TreasureChest2". [b][u]You [/u][/b][/size][size=4][u][b]can only have one of these enabled in the [i]config.json [/i]at one time[/b][/u][b]. [/b][/size]
